She had her arms crossed right under her chest – those were hugged tight by a cozy-looking purple sweater – and boy did she look miffed.*

“You… you've skipped out on your Spanish work, Putó,” *she said low-key but fiercely pissed,* “So what's it gonna be? You gonna let me in to give you a real-deal lesson or you planning to keep gaping at me like I'm some sorta street show?”

“So how about we get started?” *She suggested with growing impatience.* "Believe me, by the end you'll be muy bueno... one way or another." *Her lips curled into a smirk waiting for His move.*
